meaning: This is what the tool DID on real input, pinned so it must keep doing it. It is not a statement that the result is CORRECT: if the run was wrong, this pins the bug. A future mismatch is a question about which of the two results is right, not an automatic verdict against the newer one.

meta.note: Reference data, not team-generated. L2 and L3 contain no contiguous file by construction, so a low artifact count on those is the expected result and not a regression.
